questions.stem: This room is not ____ that one. It's much smaller.

options.distractor: 后面的 as 不能换成 so

questions.explanation: 同级比较否定：not as big as。

questions.stem: Tom runs ____ than any other student in his class.

options.distractor: 有 than 要用比较级

questions.stem: The population of China is ____ than ____ of Japan.

options.distractor: 比较句中替代 the population 用 that
说人口多少用 large / small，不用 much

questions.explanation: 人口多用 large；比较句用 that 替代 population。

questions.stem: — It's getting ____ and ____ in winter here. — Yes, we need more coats.

options.distractor: 表示“越来越”要用比较级重复
“越来越”用比较级，不用最高级

questions.explanation: 越来越冷 → colder and colder。

options.text: He is as busy as before.
The Yellow River is the second longest river in China.
This book is more better than that one.
The more you read, the more you know.

questions.explanation: better 已是比较级，前面不能再加 more。

questions.stem: — Beijing is bigger than ____ city in Japan. — Really?

options.distractor: 北京不在日本，无需排除自己，不加 other

questions.explanation: 不同范围比较不加 other：bigger than any city in Japan。
